answer.reason: The verses tell of several things done by or happening to this priest beyond what the summary states.

clauses.english: was sent by King Zedekiah to ask Jeremiah to enquire of the LORD
clauses.quote: Enquire, I pray thee, of the LORD for us

clauses.english: read Shemaiah's letter in the hearing of Jeremiah the prophet
clauses.quote: Zephaniah the priest read this letter in the ears of Jeremiah the prophet.

clauses.english: was taken by the captain of the guard to the king of Babylon at Riblah
clauses.quote: the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest

doubts: JER 37:3 tells of a second sending to Jeremiah, to pray for the people; left out to avoid repeating the first.
